caseName: Spaulding v. U.S. Dist. Court for the D.C.
caseNameFull: Levon SPAULDING v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR the DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
